description: For positive finite n and k, every k-colouring of the n-element subsets of the natural numbers has an infinite homogeneous subset.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.infinite_ramsey {n k : ℕ} (_hn : 0 < n) (hk : 0 < k)
  (c : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.Coloring ℕ n (Fin k)) :
  ∃ H, H.Infinite ∧ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.PartitionRelations.IsHomogeneous c H
